notes: Local telemetry uses the manufacturer's Hopewind protocol 0237 through the generic Modbus catalog driver.
Runtime identifies a protocol family, not an exact retail model. AC generation is not household load or a site grid-import/export measurement.

known_limitations: No built-in inverter controls, including in Full Control mode.
Serial number, packed firmware versions and boot/shutdown timestamps are not decoded in this first read-only profile; raw support evidence retains their registers.
Additional MPPT/string and fault-word sensors are disabled by default; raw fault words are not decoded alarm descriptions.
Cloud analysis is independent; no further cloud credentials are needed for local polling.
knowledge_summary: Successful FC03 block reads match protocol 567/0237. The read-only family provides PV channels, AC generation, line-to-line grid voltages, phase currents, frequency, temperature, energy counters and diagnostics.
